text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in the title and opening sentence","quality":"explicit stance","description":"The essay states its position immediately and makes the reader know exactly what it is arguing for."},{"evidence":"three body paragraphs each focused on a separate reason","quality":"organized development","description":"The essay is structured into distinct claims that build the argument in a more controlled way."},{"evidence":"uses the Google half-million-miles example to support claims","quality":"textual evidence use","description":"The essay more directly brings in details from the source article to back up its points."},{"evidence":"explains how driverless cars could reduce drunk-driving and elderly-driver problems","quality":"argument relevance","description":"The reasons stay closely tied to practical benefits of the technology rather than drifting into general opinion."},{"evidence":"concluding restatement of the three reasons","quality":"effective conclusion","description":"The ending revisits the main points and closes the argument more decisively."}]}
